infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MOZHI needs camera access to capture photos and videos for posts, stories, reels, and video calls.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: MOZHI needs microphone access for voice notes, audio posts, and voice/video calling.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MOZHI needs photo library access so you can select and share media.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MOZHI needs permission to save photos and videos to your library.

plugins.cameraPermission: Allow MOZHI to access your camera

plugins.photosPermission: Allow MOZHI to access your photos
